verdict.rationale: Inngest documents an official MCP server that lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or other MCP clients inspect and operate Inngest, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists. The evidence is limited to that one doc snippet plus the probe, so details on scope and setup are thin. Missing for 10: specifics on exposed tools/operations and authentication/setup, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.
